prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing.
Create a high-fidelity design review board for the existing 8x Social hero, with ONE large finished desktop hero at the top (roughly 75% of the board), and THREE small edge-detail motion frames below. Landscape board, generous resolution and crisp typography.

Input 1 is the EXISTING HERO screenshot: preserve its carbon-black background, actual 8x social logo, navigation, exact copy, large two-line headline, orange CTA and inset orange disc behind the people. Keep the same five people in the same order, their faces, expressions, full heads and complete shoulders/upper torsos. Match their photographic realism and monochrome lighting. Keep the hero within a complete desktop viewport, no chopped shoulders at sides, no enlarged heads.
Input 2 is the BORDER STYLE reference only: fine circular halftone dots soften the photograph's rectangular perimeter into its surrounding page. Use that fine printing/raster edge vocabulary, NOT a new portrait composition and NOT its stone page background.

Change ONLY the portrait perimeter treatment in the existing hero. A very narrow, sophisticated warm-grey halftone mesh blends the far left/right edge and lower shoulder silhouette into the surrounding carbon canvas. Dots are small, individually round, densely packed near the image and taper to tiny sparse points outward over a 25-40px zone. They follow the soft outer framing of the portrait group, not a glowing outline around each person's face. Faint charcoal dot layers behind the group provide restrained depth. The actual faces, hair detail, chest and central photograph remain entirely clean and continuous. The orange disc remains a solid graphic behind the fourth person, not a new effect. No visible image rectangle, new box, enclosing line, glow, dots over faces, clouds, spirals, giant particles or dramatic scatter. This should be minimal enough for a premium startup homepage.

Exact existing UI text:
logo: "8x social"
navigation: "The network", "How it works", "For creators", "Let’s talk"
heading: "Your brand." / "A world of voices."
support: "We build and manage creator networks for your brand."
CTA: "Build your network"
Do not add captions, helper text or controls to the website mockup.

Below the hero, on a stone review-board margin, show three CLOSE-UP crops of the SAME left shoulder/image edge (not repeated whole hero sections). The portrait is absolutely identical in all three crops. Show only a tiny change in the halftone edge's radius and density, like a soft tide: at 0s resting, 3s gently expanded by 2px, 6s returned. Modulation is coherent, not randomized noise. Label these outside the crops only: "0s / Rest", "3s / Breathe", "6s / Return". Include one short board-only note: "Still portraits. A living edge." Clearly these are illustrative still keyframes, not a claim of actual video. No section dividers in the real hero. Highest care with typography, restrained details and preservation of the supplied people.
